snippet.description:

Fake MrBeast giveaways, AI influencers who don’t exist, crypto kings, online scams and the internet drama around them.

Each video is a full scam documentary built from court documents, FBI affidavits, police reports and the real footage. No rumors, no guessing. If something is only alleged, I say so.

I research, write and edit every video myself in After Effects.

If you like fraud documentaries and want to know how these schemes actually work, and how not to fall for one, subscribe for the next case.
